name: AK-47
caliber: 7.62 NATO (as written on the wiki infobox)
tagline: The Terrorists' hard-hitting workhorse rifle: huge damage, wild recoil.
summary: The AK-47 is the Terrorist faction's standard assault rifle in Counter-Strike Online and a basic (Common-grade) weapon purchasable in Original mode. It deals high damage per hit and has a short reload, but its recoil is very high, so sustained spraying quickly destroys accuracy. Its Counter-Terrorist counterpart is the M4A1.
description: Designed by Mikhail Kalashnikov and manufactured by Izmash, the AK-47 is fed with 30 rounds of 7.62 ammunition and fires in automatic mode. In Counter-Strike Online it is the Terrorist-exclusive basic rifle of Original mode ($2500 in match). The wiki characterises it as doing high damage per hit but with high recoil, so spraying makes the user lose accuracy tremendously; controlled bursts or single taps at range are the intended play style. Its damage listed by mode: 28 (Normal), 40-47 (Zombie), 56-66 (Scenario). Rated stats: accuracy 83%, recoil 21%, rate of fire 91%. The AK-47 has spawned a long line of reskins and reworks in CSO (Dragon, 60R, Gold, AKM, HQ, Red, Paladin, White Gold, 10th Anniversary).
obtainMethod: Basic weapon; purchasable by Terrorists (exclusive in Original mode)
advantages: High damage for an assault rifle
disadvantages: Loses accuracy after just several shots
Very loud, reveals the shooter's position
Purchasable only for Terrorists in Original mode
trivia: Its Counter-Terrorist counterpart in Original mode is the M4A1.
Designer credited on the wiki: Mikhail Kalashnikov.
_notes: Base weapon available since launch; the wiki page did not expose per-region release dates in our fetch. Variant list is given on the wiki as a compact list (Dragon | 60R | Gold | AKM | HQ | Red | Paladin | White Gold | 10th Anniversary) and has been expanded to full names here.
